text:
ellie: Heads-up — QA just hit a case where tenant-level snooze + high-priority routing both exist. Alert shows as SNOOZED in console but routing still fired to the escalation route.
ryan: ugh. can you paste the SLO/id and repro steps? is this consistent or one-off?
samir: likely related to notify precedence. current eval flow is: evaluate routing -> apply snooze as a filter. we intended tenant-snooze to short-circuit earlier.
dina: confirmed on staging. when tenant has snooze:true the notify pipeline still passes the event to route selection before the snooze check. looks like a missing early exit.
ellie: repro: create tenant A, set snooze window for 1h, trigger SLO breach for route=escalate-high. console badge shows SNOOZED but downstream router logs show HTTP POST to escalation webhook.
ryan: can we fix in the notify API or is it a console-only display mismatch?
samir: code excerpt from evaluator:```python
# simplified
order = ["route_selection", "policy_expansion", "snooze_apply"]
# should be: tenant_snooze -> route_selection -> ...
```
dina: small change in evaluator ordering should fix it. but we need to consider tenants that rely on route_selection to populate context used by snooze rules (rare). need backward-compatible rollout.
ellie: proposal: land server-side change behind feature-flag `snooze-precedence-v2`, default off. console will read effective flags and show badge logic unchanged until flag on for tenant. then enable for 10% tenants -> 50% -> all. add telemetry for mismatches. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ryan: agree. telemetry we should capture: `notify_eval_latency`, `snooze_applied`, `route_fired` and a counter `snooze_route_mismatch{tenant}`. Add a Grafana dashboard panel and an alert if mismatches > 1% for 10m.
samir: prometheus queries I used:```promql
sum by(tenant) (increase(redwood_notify_route_fired_total[10m]))
sum by(tenant) (increase(redwood_notify_snooze_applied_total[10m]))
(sum by(tenant)(increase(redwood_notify_route_fired_total[10m])) - sum by(tenant)(increase(redwood_notify_snooze_applied_total[10m])))
```
ops-sre: would prefer a per-tenant SLO for mismatch rate and automatic rollback for >0.5% on prod tenants.
dina: UI note: console should show explicit reason on the alert card: "Suppressed by tenant snooze" vs "Delivered: route X". currently badge text ambiguous. small UX change but high value. also add a hover tooltip with the evaluated policy order.
alertbot: [info] test-alert: tenant=acme-corp id=slob-42 state=SNOOZED evaluated_policies=[global_suspend, route_selection, tenant_snooze]
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: notify-service v1.12.3 -> will include feature-flag gate for snooze precedence.
ellie: action items: 1) samir PR with evaluator reorder + flag (link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1209) 2) ryan to add telemetry & Grafana panel 3) dina to update console badge + tooltip 4) ops-sre to define rollback threshold. I'll create tickets and link in the PR. ping me if you want on-call for canary. :thumbsup:
